description_en: Queries the tags that are added to AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters, or the AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters that have tags added
description_zh: 调用ListTagResources查询一个或多个AnalyticDB MySQL集群已绑定的标签列表，或者查询一个或多个标签绑定的AnalyticDB MySQL集群列表
kebab_example: aliyun adb list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type dbclusterlakeversion --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，您可通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to dbclusterlakeversion
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型定义。唯一取值：dbclusterlakeversion
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
parameters.help_zh: 用来返回更多结果。第一次查询不需要提供这个参数，如果一次查询没有返回全部结果，则可在后续查询中传入前一次返回的 Token 继续查询
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID. You can specify N cluster IDs. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

You must specify at least one of the ResourceId.N and Tag.N.Key parameters
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。支持同时传入多个集群ID，N的取值范围为：1~50。
ResourceId.N参数和Tag.N.Key参数至少传入一个
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key. You can specify N tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

You must specify at least one of the ResourceId.N and Tag.N.Key parameters
fields.help_zh:
标签键。支持同时传入多个标签键，不允许传入空字符串。N的取值范围为：1~20。

ResourceId.N参数和Tag.N.Key参数至少传入一个
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. You can specify N tag values. The tag value can be an empty string. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 标签键对应的标签值。支持同时传入多个标签值，允许传入空字符串。N的取值范围为：1~20
fields.name: value

NextToken.description_en: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
NextToken.description_zh: 用来返回更多结果。如果一次查询没有返回全部结果，则可在后续查询中传入前一次返回的 token 继续查询
